# Image credits

The images in this folder are for the README and the repository's social preview. The app, its
icon and the format renders are Specular's own; the pictures shown in them are by others.

The screenshots are rendered from the app by
[`tools/screenshots/make.py`](../../tools/screenshots/make.py), which downloads the photos
below; the Linux store screenshots in `packaging/linux/screenshots/` come from the same renders.

## Photos in the screenshots

All from [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com), used under the [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license):
[@v2osk](https://unsplash.com/@v2osk), [@lucamicheli](https://unsplash.com/@lucamicheli),
[@tetiana_gry](https://unsplash.com/@tetiana_gry), [@tomqtom](https://unsplash.com/@tomqtom),
[@sortino](https://unsplash.com/@sortino), [@lightscape](https://unsplash.com/@lightscape),
[@dnevozhai](https://unsplash.com/@dnevozhai), [@patkrupa](https://unsplash.com/@patkrupa),
[@coombez](https://unsplash.com/@coombez),
[@patrickbigelow_zoom_in](https://unsplash.com/@patrickbigelow_zoom_in),
[@alef_visuals](https://unsplash.com/@alef_visuals), [@markkuiper](https://unsplash.com/@markkuiper)
and [@adamjang](https://unsplash.com/@adamjang).

The hero is Vestrahorn by [@lucamicheli](https://unsplash.com/@lucamicheli). The molecule in
`molecule.webp` is haemoglobin, PDB entry 4HHB (Fermi and Perutz, 1984), from the
[RCSB Protein Data Bank](https://www.rcsb.org/structure/4HHB), CC0.

## Format wall (`formats.webp`)

Each tile is Specular's own rendering of the file, made with `specular --thumbnail IN OUT 1024`.

| Tile | File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| FITS | `AIA20110607_063302_0171_lowres.fits` | NASA SDO/AIA 171 Å, 7 June 2011, via SunPy sample data | Public domain (NASA) |
| PDS3 | `3183ML1004700001205135C00_DRXX.IMG` | NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS, Curiosity Mastcam, sol 3183 | Public domain (NASA) |
| Aperio SVS | `CMU-1-Small-Region.svs` | OpenSlide test data, Carnegie Mellon University | CC0 1.0 |
| PDB | `4HHB.pdb` | RCSB Protein Data Bank, haemoglobin (Fermi and Perutz, 1984) | CC0 |
| glTF | `Camera_01_1k.gltf` | Poly Haven "Camera 01" by Rajil Jose Macatangay | CC0 |
| NIfTI | `sub-01_T1w.nii.gz` | OpenNeuro ds000001 | CC0 |
| MPEG audio | `XC707075.mp3` | Herring gull flight call, Sonothèque ADVL, xeno-canto XC707075 | CC0 |
| MPEG-4 | `GSFC_20181022_ICON_m12902_Airglow~medium.mp4` | NASA Goddard Space Flight Center | NASA media, not copyrighted |
| GeoJSON | `ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson` | Natural Earth | Public domain |
